dedupe_keys.name: polyphenol extraction from industrial water by products a case study of the ultimate project in the fruit processing industry

description: The study applies a mobile wastewater-treatment unit at a juice factory in Nafplio, Greece, to adsorb polyphenols from orange-juice by-product streams onto a polymeric resin. It compares conventional solvent extraction, subcritical water and supercritical carbon-dioxide extraction. The authors use UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS to identify extract profiles and report the greatest diversity and abundance for the supercritical-carbon-dioxide method. These are findings of the documented treatment case; economic viability is discussed without a verified profit estimate in the abstract. The related analytical supplement is separately catalogued. Treatment scale, operating period and transferability remain limited by the metadata. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access.
